draft.sharing_review: Review the selected content and data policy, then confirm sharing. No model request was started.
agent.report_unavailable: This report cannot be selected. Choose a completed email campaign at least 72 hours old whose snapshot has not expired, or continue without a report.
agent.tools_unavailable: This model did not pass the tool-calling check. An integration manager can change the model or test it again in AI settings. Saved drafts remain available.
notify.agentBody: Open your task to review its progress and choose what happens next. Nothing has been sent or published.
agent.input: Enter a brief, choose a language and use the current plan or resource revision.
agent.changed: This run or plan changed. Refresh and review the latest version before deciding.
agent.permission: Your current permissions do not allow this action. Completed drafts remain available where you still have access.
agent.unavailable: The agent or model connection is unavailable. An integration manager can restore it; your drafts are preserved.
agent.expired: This run has expired. Its temporary content is no longer available; kept drafts are unchanged.
agent.manual: The output still failed validation after two repairs. Review successful drafts and edit the remaining content manually.
agent.decided: This draft already has a different decision. Refresh to see the saved result.
agent.request_reused: This request key was already used for a different brief. Submit the brief again to start a new run.
agent.bundle: Review the exact current versions of every undecided draft in this dependency bundle together.
budget.reconcile_confirm: Verify both token counts with the provider and confirm them. Zero means the provider confirmed no charge, not unknown usage.
budget.reconcile_changed: This request was already reconciled with different counts. Refresh to see its recorded usage.
budget.reconcile_wait: This request may still be running. Reconciliation is available ten minutes after it started.
budget.connection_changed: The model connection or access changed. Refresh before trying again; no new request was sent.
budget.price_unknown: Cost unknown. An integration manager must configure both model prices before another request can be sent.
budget.context_limit: This request exceeds the context limit. Reduce the selected content; no request was sent.
budget.reservation_cap: The remaining monthly budget cannot cover this request and requests already in flight. Wait for them to finish or ask an integration manager to raise the cap.
budget.run_cap: The remaining run budget cannot cover this request. Keep the completed drafts, reduce the task or ask an integration manager to raise the cumulative limit.
budget.usage_unknown: Cost unknown. The provider did not return trustworthy usage. The reserved budget is held until an integration manager reconciles it; this request will not be repeated automatically.
draft.input: Enter a brief and name, choose a language, and use complete HTTP(S) links. Existing drafts need their exact current revision.
draft.privacy: This context may contain personal data or credentials. Remove it locally before generating a draft; nothing was sent.
draft.source: This source cannot be safely projected for AI drafting. Use a plain template or edit the unsupported blocks manually.
draft.changed: Changed since this proposal. Generate and review a new proposal; the current draft was not changed.
draft.refused: The model declined this brief. No draft was created or changed.
draft.invalid: The generated draft failed content validation. No draft was created or changed. Revise the brief or edit manually.
draft.unavailable: Draft generation was disabled while the model was working. No draft was created or changed.
draft.decided: This proposal already has a different decision. Refresh to see the saved result.
voice.privacy: The selected text may contain personal data or credentials. Remove it locally or choose another campaign; nothing was sent.
voice.empty: Choose campaigns with unrendered text to learn from.
voice.unavailable: Brand voice learning is no longer available. Your saved voice was not changed.

problem.notConnected.note: an AI feature was used before a model was connected; the reader can connect one

problem.notConnectedAlone: No AI model is connected to this workspace. Someone who can manage integrations can connect one in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.

problem.capReachedAlone: This month's AI budget ({cap}) is used up. AI features return on {date}, or someone who can manage integrations can raise the cap.

problem.keyRejected.message: The workspace's model key was rejected by {provider}. Nothing was sent. {helpers} can replace it.
problem.keyRejected.note: provider: Anthropic, OpenAI…; helpers: names joined as 'A or B'

problem.keyRejectedAlone: The workspace's model key was rejected by {provider}. Nothing was sent. Someone who can manage integrations can replace it in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.

problem.providerErrorTwice.message: {provider} returned an error ({status}, {code}) twice. Nothing was changed.

problem.providerError.message: {provider} returned an error ({status}, {code}). Nothing was changed.

problem.rateLimitedNow: {provider} is limiting requests from this workspace. Try again in a minute; nothing was changed.

problem.timeout.message: {provider} didn't answer within {seconds} seconds. Nothing was changed.

problem.unreachable.message: {provider} couldn't be reached ({detail}). Nothing was changed.

problem.blocked.message: {host} is a private address, and this instance doesn't allow private addresses. An instance admin can allow them.

problem.badRequest.message: {provider} refused the request: {detail}. Nothing was changed.

problem.unreadable: {provider}'s answer couldn't be read. Nothing was changed.

problem.noImageInputAlone: Alt text needs a model that reads images. Someone who can manage integrations can connect one that does.

problem.demoLanguage.message: The demo's sample model translates into Spanish and German only. To translate into {language}, connect your own model in Settings › Integrations · AI assistant.
problem.demoLanguage.note: the demo connection was asked for a language its recordings lack; language: Vietnamese

problem.privateAddress.message: {host} resolves to {ip}, a private address. An instance admin can allow private addresses.

problem.privateHost.message: {host} is a private address. An instance admin can allow private addresses.

problem.badAddress.message: Use the server's full address, like {example}.

problem.azureNeeds: Paste your Azure OpenAI endpoint (like https://acme.openai.azure.com) and the deployment's name.
problem.modelNeeded: Pick a model, or type its name.

problem.oneModel.message: One model per workspace: disconnect {provider} first to switch provider.

problem.notConnectedYet: No AI model is connected yet. Connect one first.

problem.capRange.message: Set a monthly cap between {min} and {max}, or choose no cap.
problem.capRange.note: min, max: amounts in dollars, $1.00 and $100,000.00

problem.tokenCapRange.message: Set a token cap of at least {min} tokens a month, or choose no cap.

problem.priceRange.message: Prices are dollars per million tokens, between {min} and {max}.

problem.unknownFeature: That isn't one of the assistant's features.

problem.tooLong.message: That's more text than the assistant takes at once ({count} characters, up to {max}). Select a part of it.

problem.instructionNeeded: Write what to change, for example "Make it shorter and friendlier".

problem.imageUnreadable.note: detail: why, such as: it is over 5 MB

problem.imageMissing: Pick an image first: this one has no address.

image.address.note: why an image can't be read, after “The image couldn't be read:”

image.notInLibrary: it isn't in this workspace's media library
image.where: only images on the web or in the media library can be described

image.status.note: status: an HTTP status, such as 404

image.format: it isn't a PNG, JPEG or GIF image
problem.suggestionGone: That suggestion isn't yours, or it's older than a day. Ask for a new one.
problem.noSourceText: The source version has no text to translate yet.
problem.sameLanguage: Pick a language other than the one the email is written in.

problem.notWorkspaceLanguage.message: {language} isn't one of this workspace's languages. Add it in Settings › General › Languages first.

problem.sourceChanged: The email changed since this translation was made. Translate it again.
problem.nothingAccepted: Accept at least one block, or reject the translation.
problem.descriptionNeeded: Describe who should be in the segment, for example "clicked in the last 30 days but didn't open".
problem.notSent: This campaign hasn't sent anything yet, so there are no results to summarize.

problem.campaignId.note: a request without the campaign it is about

problem.questionEmpty.message: Ask a question about this report.
problem.questionEmpty.note: the Ask box was sent empty

problem.suggestionId.note: a request without the suggestion it keeps or accepts

problem.modelExists.note: model: gpt-5-mini; an account has each model (and Azure deployment) once

problem.modelInUse.note: removing a model features use; features: their names joined as 'A and B', such as Alt text and Draft from a brief

problem.accountInUse.note: removing an account whose models features use; features: as in problem.modelInUse

problem.accountDisconnected.note: picking the model a feature uses

problem.toolsUnchecked.note: picking the model the agent or the assistant uses

problem.personalKeyRejected.note: a personal key; provider: Anthropic, OpenAI…
